name: PreTranscode
description:
Kutuphanedeki dosyalari arka planda hedef codec'e once kodlayarak Direct Play oranini artirir.

Orijinal dosyalara dokunmaz, her dosyanin yanina optimize edilmis bir kopya uretir. Jellyfin Dashboard uzerinden kutuphane secimi ve tek tikla kodlama saglar.
overview: Arka planda once kodlama yaparak Direct Play oranini artirir

versions.changelog: Fix CSS not rendering - inject via script to avoid Jellyfin stripping style tags
Premium UI redesign - native Jellyfin components, 3 tabs (Library/Jobs/Settings), enhanced job panel with encoder type/ETA/speed info, job summary with savings stats
Fix VAAPI h264 encoding on AMD GPUs - use hwdownload+format=nv12+hwupload for 10-bit to 8-bit conversion
Fix VAAPI h264 encoding on AMD GPUs - add profile:v main parameter
Fix cancel button endpoint, fix VAAPI h264 with 10-bit sources (use nv12|vaapi format filter)
